_comment: Comprehensive URDF validation rules derived from repository analysis

required_root.description: Root element must be <robot> with a name attribute
required_root.violation_error: XML must have <robot> as root element

minimum_components.description: Robot must have at least one <link> element

link_uniqueness.rule: All link names must be unique
link_uniqueness.check: Count of unique link names == count of all links

joint_uniqueness.rule: All joint names must be unique
joint_uniqueness.check: Count of unique joint names == count of all joints

joint_connectivity.parent_exists: Joint parent link must be defined
joint_connectivity.child_exists: Joint child link must be defined
joint_connectivity.parent_child_different: Parent and child links must be different

violation_errors.self_loop: Joint '{joint_name}' has same parent and child link

tree_structure.no_cycles: Kinematic tree must be acyclic (no loops)
tree_structure.single_root: Tree should have one root link (or explicitly defined base)
tree_structure.description: URDF represents a kinematic tree, not a graph with cycles

warnings.too_large: mass > 1000 unusual for most robots, verify value

diagonal_positive.description: Diagonal elements must be strictly positive

triangle_inequality.description: Physical validity constraint for rigid body inertia
triangle_inequality.violation_error: Inertia matrix violates triangle inequality - not physically realizable

off_diagonal_bounded.description: Off-diagonal elements bounded by diagonal elements

relation.description: Static friction should be >= dynamic friction

collision_geometry.recommended: Every link with mass should have collision geometry
collision_geometry.best_practice: Use primitives for faster collision checking when possible

visual_geometry.recommended: Every link should have visual geometry for visualization

geometry_scale.warning: Geometries larger than 10m or smaller than 1mm may cause issues

drake_gear_ratio.description: Gear ratio for reflected rotor inertia

drake_rotor_inertia.description: Rotor inertia reflected through gear ratio

drake_collision_filter_group.description: Define collision filter groups to ignore certain collisions

missing_inertial.consequence: Drake may use default inertia or throw error
missing_inertial.fix: Add <inertial> with mass and inertia tensor
missing_inertial.exception: Static (welded) links without mass are OK

zero_mass.consequence: Numerical instability or division by zero
zero_mass.fix: Use small positive mass (e.g., 0.001) instead of zero

invalid_inertia.consequence: Simulation may explode or behave unrealistically
invalid_inertia.fix: Recalculate inertia using proper formulas or CAD export
invalid_inertia.tools: Use Drake's CalcSpatialInertia or MeshLab for mesh inertia

undefined_parent_child.consequence: Parser error, URDF fails to load
undefined_parent_child.fix: Ensure all <parent> and <child> links are defined

missing_axis.consequence: Default axis used (may not be intended)

validation_checklist: ✓ All parent/child links in joints exist
✓ All masses are positive and reasonable
✓ All inertia matrices satisfy triangle inequality
✓ Effort and velocity limits are positive
✓ Collision geometries defined for physical links
✓ Mesh file paths are correct and files exist
